title: Morphisms with torsion cone
statement:
In the situation of [lem-sfb-torsion-triangulated], let $W_M$ be the class of morphisms
$f\colon X\to Y$ of $\mathcal T$ whose mapping cone is $M$-torsion, i.e. those that sit
in a distinguished triangle $X\xrightarrow{f}Y\to Z\to X[1]$ with $Z$ $M$-torsion. These
are the morphisms inverted in the Verdier quotient by the $M$-torsion objects.

lean.note: The existing reducible definition is (torsion M C).trW. Mathlib ObjectProperty.trW expands exactly to the existence of Z, g : Y ⟶ Z, h : Z ⟶ X⟦1⟧ and a distinguished Triangle.mk f g h with torsion M C Z. The latter is ∃ m ∈ M, m • 𝟙 Z = 0. The same upstream module defines Rationalization M C as (W M C).Localization and its canonical functor Q, so W is precisely the defining class inverted in the Verdier quotient. The current source path is DerivedCategory/Complete/Rationalization.lean, replacing the stale path in the inherited attachment. No new definition or module is needed.
